nodes.name: PROJECT_MAP.md
nodes.summary: Vietnamese project map of the Zalo assistant bot: a 2D architecture matrix of modules by layer and subsystem, per-file purpose notes, and a quick lookup table by need.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main Vietnamese README covering setup on Windows, first Zalo run, desktop app and web admin, VPS control, webhook mode, personal-account mode, group filters, command reference and how to add assistant tools.

nodes.name: ZaloBot.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that creates a .venv and installs the package with desktop and personal extras on first run, then starts the management GUI via pythonw (python -m bot gui) forwarding any arguments.
nodes.languageNotes: ASCII-only batch using goto labels (run, nopython, failed) for control flow.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Setuptools project definition for zalo-assistant-bot declaring core dependencies (httpx, google-genai, FastAPI, uvicorn), optional extras (dev, personal, desktop, build), the zalo-bot console script, package data and pytest settings.
